commit_message:
[Merged] Fix a buffer overread that could occur in fts5 within a memcmp() when doing an integrity-check on corrupted records.

FossilOrigin-Name: f73adcfc87803f373b7c55ec280e3bcae4b9f3a1f3edc2ee21bf12c696a46be4
pr_title: Check FTS5 leaf-term bounds before integrity-check comparisons
pr_description:
Validate leaf-term boundaries before comparing terms during FTS5 integrity checks. Calculate the term end using 64-bit arithmetic so oversized lengths in corrupted records are rejected before the memory comparison.

Validation: the PR state applies cleanly against the parent revision, and git diff --check passes.

@@ -8533,23 +8533,27 @@ static void fts5IndexIntegrityCheckSegment(
       int iRowidOff;              /* Offset of first rowid on leaf */
       int nTerm;                  /* Size of term on leaf in bytes */
       int res;                    /* Comparison of term and split-key */
 
       iOff = fts5LeafFirstTermOff(pLeaf);
       iRowidOff = fts5LeafFirstRowidOff(pLeaf);
       if( iRowidOff>=iOff || iOff>=pLeaf->szLeaf ){
         FTS5_CORRUPT_ROWID(p, iRow);
       }else{
         iOff += fts5GetVarint32(&pLeaf->p[iOff], nTerm);
-        res = fts5Memcmp(&pLeaf->p[iOff], zIdxTerm, MIN(nTerm, nIdxTerm));
-        if( res==0 ) res = nTerm - nIdxTerm;
-        if( res<0 ) FTS5_CORRUPT_ROWID(p, iRow);
+        if( (i64)iOff+(i64)nTerm>(i64)pLeaf->szLeaf ){
+          FTS5_CORRUPT_ROWID(p, iRow);
+        }else{
+          res = fts5Memcmp(&pLeaf->p[iOff], zIdxTerm, MIN(nTerm, nIdxTerm));
+          if( res==0 ) res = nTerm - nIdxTerm;
+          if( res<0 ) FTS5_CORRUPT_ROWID(p, iRow);
+        }
       }
 
       fts5IntegrityCheckPgidx(p, iRow, pLeaf);
     }
     fts5DataRelease(pLeaf);
     if( p->rc ) break;
 
     /* Now check that the iter.nEmpty leaves following the current leaf
     ** (a) exist and (b) contain no terms. */
     fts5IndexIntegrityCheckEmpty(

intro_commit_message:
Fix a buffer overread that could occur in fts5 within a memcmp() when doing an integrity-check on corrupted records.

FossilOrigin-Name: f73adcfc87803f373b7c55ec280e3bcae4b9f3a1f3edc2ee21bf12c696a46be4
fix_commit_message:
Do not allow an integer overflow to bypass a leaf-term bound check in the integrity-check function of FTS5. [bugs:/info/2026-06-27T18:47:28Z|Bug 2026-06-27T18:47:28Z]

FossilOrigin-Name: 74ba971bfafae1eba5e4f4a36e3b31f603f37cdc2010ee09ac251d6e863ac8b0
agent_reasoning: The original bound check added iOff and the database-controlled nTerm using signed int arithmetic. An overflowing sum could bypass the leaf boundary guard and permit a buffer overread in fts5Memcmp. Casting both operands to i64 before addition and comparing against the i64 leaf size preserves the bound check. The only additional source edit is the supplied one-line change in ext/fts5/fts5_index.c; no test files were modified.
